title: Jackass: Best and Last
plot_overview: The longtime stunt-comedy crew reunites for one final round of outrageous challenges, painful pranks, and reckless antics. Blending familiar chaos with the feeling of a farewell, the film celebrates the bond behind their outrageous adventures while pushing their tolerance for embarrassment and danger.
will_you_like_this: You’ll likely enjoy this if you already love the franchise’s reckless stunts, crude humor, and group chemistry; Not for you if staged pain and juvenile chaos make you cringe.
review_summary: Pros: heartfelt farewell; committed performers; familiar chaos | Cons: juvenile humor; repetitive antics; frequent cringe
